#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fill declared {{FIELD}} placeholders in a DOCX, including split runs,
body, nested tables, and active headers/footers. Handles the
{{IF_RELOCATION}}...{{END_IF_RELOCATION}} conditional governed solely by
RELOCATION_PACKAGE (kept only when the value is exactly "Yes").

No installs, no network, no macros, no cross-paragraph tokens.
"""
import sys, os, re, json, zipfile, shutil
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
WNS = '{%s}' % W

INPUT_DOCX = 'inputs/offer_letter_template.docx'
DATA_JSON = 'inputs/employee_data.json'
OUTPUT_DOCX = 'output/offer_letter_filled.docx'

PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r'\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}')
IF_OPEN = '{{IF_RELOCATION}}'
IF_CLOSE = '{{END_IF_RELOCATION}}'


def fail(msg):
    sys.stderr.write('ERROR: ' + msg + '\n')
    sys.exit(1)


def local(tag):
    return tag.split('}', 1)[-1] if '}' in tag else tag


def iter_paragraphs(root):
    for el in root.iter(WNS + 'p'):
        yield el


def get_t_elems(p):
    """Return list of w:t elements in document order within a paragraph,
    excluding those inside a nested paragraph (nested tables' paragraphs are
    separate <w:p> elements and handled on their own iteration)."""
    result = []
    for child in p.iter(WNS + 't'):
        result.append(child)
    return result


def paragraph_text_segments(p):
    """Return (t_elems, texts) restricted to this paragraph's own runs,
    not descending into nested <w:p> (nested table paragraphs)."""
    t_elems = []

    def walk(node):
        for child in list(node):
            if child.tag == WNS + 'p' and node is not p:
                # a nested paragraph - skip (handled separately)
                continue
            if child.tag == WNS + 'p' and node is p:
                # shouldn't happen for p itself
                pass
            if child.tag == WNS + 't':
                t_elems.append(child)
            else:
                # don't descend into nested paragraphs
                if child.tag == WNS + 'p':
                    continue
                walk(child)

    walk(p)
    return t_elems


def process_paragraph(p, mapping, relocation_keep, stats):
    t_elems = paragraph_text_segments(p)
    if not t_elems:
        return
    texts = [(el.text or '') for el in t_elems]
    full = ''.join(texts)

    if '{{' not in full:
        return

    new_full = full

    # Handle conditional first (confined to one paragraph by spec).
    if IF_OPEN in new_full or IF_CLOSE in new_full:
        if IF_OPEN in new_full and IF_CLOSE in new_full:
            # governed solely by RELOCATION_PACKAGE
            def repl_cond(m):
                inner = m.group(1)
                return inner if relocation_keep else ''
            new_full = re.sub(
                re.escape(IF_OPEN) + r'(.*?)' + re.escape(IF_CLOSE),
                repl_cond, new_full, flags=re.S)
            stats['conditional'] += 1
        else:
            # Unbalanced within a paragraph => cross-paragraph token: not allowed.
            fail('Conditional IF_RELOCATION spans paragraphs or is unbalanced')

    # Replace declared placeholders.
    def repl_field(m):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in ('IF_RELOCATION', 'END_IF_RELOCATION'):
            # leftover markers (shouldn't remain) - treat as missing structure
            return m.group(0)
        if name not in mapping:
            fail('Missing required value for field: %s' % name)
        stats['fields'].add(name)
        return mapping[name]

    new_full = PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(repl_field, new_full)

    if new_full == full:
        return

    # Redistribute: put the entire new text into the first w:t, empty the rest.
    # All runs in these paragraphs share identical run properties, so placement
    # and formatting are preserved.
    t_elems[0].text = new_full
    if new_full != (t_elems[0].text if False else new_full):
        pass
    _set_preserve_space(t_elems[0])
    for el in t_elems[1:]:
        el.text = ''
        _set_preserve_space(el)


def _set_preserve_space(t_el):
    # Preserve leading/trailing spaces exactly.
    t_el.set('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space', 'preserve')


def process_part(xml_bytes, mapping, relocation_keep, stats):
    ET.register_namespace('w', W)
    # Preserve other namespaces by registering as found.
    header = xml_bytes.split(b'>', 1)[0] + b'>'
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
    for p in list(iter_paragraphs(root)):
        process_paragraph(p, mapping, relocation_keep, stats)
    body = ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode')
    return body


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_DOCX):
        fail('Input DOCX not found: %s' % INPUT_DOCX)
    if not os.path.exists(DATA_JSON):
        fail('Data JSON not found: %s' % DATA_JSON)

    with open(DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    # Governing field for the conditional.
    if 'RELOCATION_PACKAGE' not in data:
        fail('Required governing field RELOCATION_PACKAGE is absent')
    reloc_val = data['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']
    if not isinstance(reloc_val, str):
        reloc_val = str(reloc_val)
    relocation_keep = (reloc_val == 'Yes')  # exact string match only

    # Build mapping of string values for substitution.
    mapping = {k: ('' if v is None else str(v)) for k, v in data.items()}

    zin = zipfile.ZipFile(INPUT_DOCX, 'r')
    names = zin.namelist()

    # Determine parts to process: document body + all active header/footer parts.
    doc_rels = zin.read('word/_rels/document.xml.rels').decode('utf-8')
    doc_xml = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
    referenced_rids = set(re.findall(
        r'<w:(?:headerReference|footerReference)[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"', doc_xml))
    rid_target = dict(re.findall(
        r'<Relationship Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', doc_rels))
    active_parts = set(['word/document.xml'])
    for rid in referenced_rids:
        tgt = rid_target.get(rid)
        if tgt:
            active_parts.add('word/' + tgt)

    stats = {'fields': set(), 'conditional': 0}

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_DOCX), exist_ok=True)
    tmp_out = OUTPUT_DOCX + '.tmp'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            raw = zin.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename in active_parts:
                decl_m = re.match(rb"<\?xml[^>]*\?>", raw)
                decl = decl_m.group(0).decode('utf-8') if decl_m else "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8' standalone='yes'?>"
                new_body = process_part(raw, mapping, relocation_keep, stats)
                out = (decl + new_body).encode('utf-8')
                zout.writestr(item, out)
            else:
                zout.writestr(item, raw)
    zin.close()
    shutil.move(tmp_out, OUTPUT_DOCX)

    sys.stderr.write('Filled fields: %s\n' % ', '.join(sorted(stats['fields'])))
    sys.stderr.write('Conditional blocks resolved: %d (keep=%s, value=%r)\n' % (
        stats['conditional'], relocation_keep, reloc_val))
    print('OK: wrote %s' % OUTPUT_DOCX)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
